Regeneration is NMOS-dominated, so the high PMOS Vth at ss/1.62 V only slows reset and output pull-up; the output PMOS is widened for that. Reset has 1 ns available at 500 MHz, which is ample. The 640 ps delay budget covers about 6 regeneration time constants plus the buffer delay at ss/125C."}

PARAMS = {
    "W_in":   (2.0, 0.84, 8.0),   # input pair width (um), L=0.15
    "W_tail": (2.5, 0.84, 8.0),   # clocked tail switch
    "W_ln":   (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # latch nfet (cross-coupled)
    "W_lp":   (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # latch pfet (cross-coupled)
    "W_rst":  (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),   # reset pfets on la/lb/X/Y
    "W_on":   (0.6, 0.42, 3.0),   # output inverter nfet
    "W_op":   (1.8, 0.42, 6.0),   # output inverter pfet (weak pfet -> wider)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 15e-15)
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch (clk high = evaluate)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_tail"], L)
    # input pair
    n.M("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    n.M("M2", "y", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["W_in"], L)
    # cross-coupled latch: vinp>vinn -> x falls first -> la low, lb high
    n.M("M3", "la", "lb", "x", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ln"], L)
    n.M("M4", "lb", "la", "y", "vss", "nfet", p["W_ln"], L)
    n.M("M5", "la", "lb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_lp"], L)
    n.M("M6", "lb", "la", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_lp"], L)
    # reset switches (clk low): precharge all internal nodes to VDD
    n.M("MR1", "la", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR2", "lb", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR3", "x", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR4", "y", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_rst"], L)
    # output inverters: outp = !la, outn = !lb (both low during reset)
    n.M("MOP1", "outp", "la", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_op"], L)
    n.M("MON1", "outp", "la", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_on"], L)
    n.M("MOP2", "outn", "lb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["W_op"], L)
    n.M("MON2", "outn", "lb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["W_on"], L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cox_w = 1.6e-15            # approx gate cap per um at L=0.15 (F/um)
    cj_w = 1.0e-15             # approx junction/overlap cap per um (F/um)
    # latch node capacitance
    c_l = (cj_w * (p["W_ln"] + p["W_lp"] + p["W_rst"])
           + cox_w * (p["W_ln"] + p["W_lp"] + p["W_on"] + p["W_op"]))
    # x/y node capacitance
    c_x = cj_w * (p["W_in"] + p["W_ln"] + p["W_rst"])
    c_clk = 0.0                # clock energy is supplied by the testbench source

    # latch transconductance from the forward LUT model
    try:
        opn = lut.op("n", p["W_ln"], L, vgs=0.9, vds=0.5)
        opp = lut.op("p", p["W_lp"], L, vgs=0.9, vds=0.5)
        gm_l = opn["gm"] + opp["gm"]
        opi = lut.op("n", p["W_in"], L, vgs=0.9, vds=0.3)
        id_in = max(opi["Id"], 1e-6)
    except Exception:
        gm_l = 1e-3 * p["W_ln"]
        id_in = 150e-6 * p["W_in"]
    gm_l = max(gm_l, 1e-5)

    tau = c_l / gm_l
    # integration phase: tail current discharges x/y and la/lb by about one Vth
    t_int = (c_l + c_x) * 0.7 / id_in
    av = 5.0
    t_reg = tau * math.log(vdd / (2 * av * dv))
    # output buffer delay (pfet pull-up into cl)
    try:
        opo = lut.op("p", p["W_op"], L, vgs=vdd, vds=0.9)
        i_up = max(opo["Id"], 1e-6)
    except Exception:
        i_up = 100e-6 * p["W_op"]
    t_buf = (cl + cj_w * (p["W_on"] + p["W_op"])) * (vdd / 2) / i_up
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_buf

    # energy per comparison: both x/y and one latch node swing fully;
    # the other latch node swings partially; one output charges cl
    c_sw = 2 * c_x + 1.5 * c_l + cl + cj_w * (p["W_on"] + p["W_op"]) + c_clk
    energy = c_sw * vdd ** 2

    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
